verdict.rationale: Reflect's docs say it automatically creates a new daily note every day for journaling (reflect-docs-26). The daily note is clearly the default capture destination: web bookmarks/highlights, voice transcriptions, deep-link appends, API appends and calendar events all land there (reflect-docs-29, reflect-docs-34, reflect-docs-46, reflect-supp-openpm-spec, reflect-docs-13). Nothing in the evidence shows daily notes can be pre-filled from a user-defined template, which is a material part of the story. Missing for 10: daily-note template pre-fill, independent or hands-on corroboration of the daily-note workflow.
